exodus.33.p1.b1.text: Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of the land of Egypt, and go to the land …

exodus.33.p1.b2.text: And I will send an angel before you, … Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey.

exodus.33.p1.b3.text: But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people; …

exodus.33.p2.b4.text: When the people heard these bad tidings, they went into mourning, and no one put on any of his jewelry.

exodus.33.p2.b5.text: Now take off your jewelry, and I will decide what to do with you.

exodus.33.p2.b6.text: So the Israelites stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.

exodus.33.p3.b7.text: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it at a distance outside the camp. He called it the Tent of Meeting, …

exodus.33.p3.b8.text: … anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp.

exodus.33.p3.b9.text: Then, whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would stand at the entrances to their own tents and watch Moses …

exodus.33.p4.b11.text: As Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and remain at the entrance, …

exodus.33.p4.b12.text: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they would stand up and worship, each one at the entrance to his own tent.

exodus.33.p4.b13.text: Thus the LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend.

exodus.33.p4.b14.text: … his young assistant Joshua son of Nun would not leave the tent.

exodus.33.p5.b15.text: You have been telling me, ‘Lead this people up,’ but You have not let me know whom You will send with me.

exodus.33.p5.b16.text: My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.

exodus.33.p5.b17.text: If Your Presence does not go with us, … do not lead us up from here.

exodus.33.p5.b18.text: … unless You go with us? How else will we be distinguished from all the other people on the face of the earth?

exodus.33.p6.b19.text: I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.

exodus.33.p6.b21.text: I will cause all My goodness to pass before you, … and I will proclaim My name—the LORD—in your presence.

exodus.33.p6.b22.text: You cannot see My face, for no one can see Me and live.

exodus.33.p7.b23.text: There is a place near Me where you are to stand upon a rock …

exodus.33.p7.b24.text: and when My glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand until I have passed by.

exodus.33.p7.b25.text: … you will see My back; but My face must not be seen.
